items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to neuron structure, types and the process of synaptic transmission.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: BBC Radio 4 programme covering neuroscience and brain chemistry — directly relevant to how neurons communicate.

items.title: The Chemical Mind: Crash Course Psychology #3
items.description: Explains neurotransmitters, synaptic gaps, excitation and inhibition — exactly the synaptic transmission content on your AQA spec.

items.title: Synaptic Transmission Animation — Neuron Signalling
items.description: Step-by-step animated breakdown of how an action potential travels across a synapse and triggers the post-synaptic cell.

items.title: What is a Neuron? Parts and Function
items.description: Covers the structure of sensory, relay and motor neurons with clear diagrams of axon, dendrites and myelin sheath.

items.title: Black Mirror — Netflix
items.description: Speculative drama series that frequently explores the brain's neural networks and digital mind-uploading concepts — a thought-provoking extension of neuron ideas.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Neurons: Structure, Function and Types
items.description: Comprehensive guide to sensory, relay and motor neurons with diagrams — ideal companion notes for this lesson.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Synaptic Transmission
items.description: Detailed explanation of the synaptic cleft, neurotransmitter release, reuptake and Hebb's theory of learning.
